title: Unity DOTS vs Handbuilt: Sample Project
summary: Nick Caston compares Unity's sample ECS/DOTS project (AngryBots) with his own from-scratch C++ and OpenGL clone. He benchmarks performance and discusses the effort involved in each approach.
why: HN uses it as concrete data in game engine debates, showing a custom engine far outperforming Unity at several times the effort.

quote.text: A custom 3D engine performs immensely better than a comparable Unity project, but it took the author 3 to 4 times the effort.
